headline: AN EARLY CELEBRATION OR THE MIDNIGHT MOMENT?

feed.alt_text: Earlier or midnight? Twisted Pin NYE, December 31, 2026. A real bowling-party photograph represents earlier family celebrations; an illustrative mirrorball represents the 10pm December 31 to 12:30am January 1 party. Only the 10pm party includes the midnight toast: champagne for guests 21 and over or sparkling cider. Families welcome at every party. www.twistedpin.com/new-years-eve/.
